message.content:
An editorial illustration for "TEMPO" magazine features a dark gray background with a red vertical border on the left. The large, bold white title "OPERASI GAGAL" is on the left. Smaller white text below details an event involving investigators from a corruption commission and a party secretary. 

The central focus is a large, dark-furred bull charging forward, its long horns spanning the width of the composition. A person in a gray vest with "KPK" on the back sits on the bull’s neck, hands gripping its head. Behind them, a person in a red jacket with glasses clings to the rider’s back. 

In the foreground, a small figure in a dark vest with "KPK" on the back stands facing away, holding a looped rope as if to lasso the bull. White text at the top reads "BABAK BARU SKANDALJIWASRAYA" and "TOKOH SENI PILIHAN TEMPO." Date, price, and barcode information are in the lower left. The overall scene depicts a dynamic, high-stakes confrontation between the large bull and the human figures.
